author: Temporal Community
name: Temporal Worker
description: Creates a single console-host project running a Temporal worker (Temporalio.Extensions.Hosting), with a resolved TemporalClientConnectOptions (env/profile -> Temporal:Address config -> localhost:7233) and optional OpenTelemetry tracing.

Framework.description: The target framework for the project.

IncludeOtel.description: Adds a 'Temporalio' ActivitySource, the client-side TracingInterceptor, and an OTLP exporter gated on the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT environment variable.
